title: How to Do a Stomach Vacuum to Shrink Your Waist
hook: The stomach vacuum is the one ab exercise that can actually pull your waist in.
body: Breathe all the way out and slump. Then stand tall, suck your stomach in like you're posing for a bodybuilding show, and hold. Do 3 sets of 20–30 seconds. It doesn't burn belly fat—it trains the deep abdominal muscle that stabilizes your core and can make your waistline look smaller.

The stomach vacuum trains your transverse abdominis to pull your waist in—even before all your belly fat is gone.

Try your free Abs By AI preview: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=stomach-vacuum&utm_content=ds-04

Breathe all the way out and slump. Stand tall, draw your stomach in like you're posing for a bodybuilding show, and hold. Do 3 sets of 20–30 seconds.

The vacuum does not burn fat from your stomach. It trains the deep abdominal muscle that stabilizes your core and can make your waistline look smaller.
